Cumulative learning through
acquired observation operations
A self-contained Astra investigation · 31 October 2026
Result. A learner can acquire exact executable functions from noisy observations, then use those
functions to align a different collection of noisy tasks into repeated observations of a new unknown
function. The relationships, useful numerical noise bounds, and task programs are acquired. The final
construction receives no hidden graph, task grouping, planted rank, or numerical noise rate.
The mechanism is conditional on a demanding but explicit observation model: uniform binary inputs,
parity tasks, and independently corrupted channel labels at the same input. It includes a procedure that
can decline when the observed evidence is insufficient. Its current-episode correctness does not require
past task associations to have been correct: fresh tests assess the actual executable functions.

executable and mathematical checks, not an empirical estimate of failure probability or evidence that a
real source meets the assumptions.
Scientific status
The contribution is a fully specified composition and organizing principle, with ordinary proofs, exact
finite decisions, code, and counterexamples. Its components have close established predecessors.
Historical priority of the complete assembly is unresolved. An ordinary retained-data learner also

Its strongest result is a conditional cumulative-learning construction:

A learner can acquire exact executable functions from noisy observations, then use those functions to discover relationships among new tasks, align their noisy measurements, and acquire a new function outside the span of its previously identified task functions.

The construction acquires its initial relationships, its useful numerical noise bounds, and its reusable programs. It receives no hidden graph, task grouping, planted rank, or numerical noise rate.

A further result establishes that current acquisition can remain sound even when earlier task associations were wrong: the learner tests the actual executable programs against fresh observations.

The decisive comparison also survives intact: an ordinary learner retaining the same observations recovered and certified every program too. The investigation therefore establishes a precise mechanism and a complete executable realization. It does not establish a practical full-cost advantage, a general solution to cumulative learning, or historical priority for the complete construction.
